    car_patches.sort(key=lambda p: p.horizontal_center)
    
    # Filter out cars that are not on the right side of the street
    right_cars = [car for car in car_patches if car.right >= image_patch.width / 2]
    
    # Further filter to get cars that are parking diagonally

                diagonal_cars.append(right_cars[i])
                diagonal_cars.append(right_cars[j])
                break
